goldenTrust: desktop-observation with source identity loss; sourceNoteIds use instrument and note ordinals after PrettyMIDI decode, not raw SMF event IDs; raw-event mapping is unavailable
loadSemantics: midi_loader.load_midi returned a Song; this does not assert UI readiness or playability

provenance.font: bundled Source Sans Pro from assets/fonts
provenance.isolatedAppDataRoot: ephemeral temporary directory, removed at process exit
provenance.profile: pianist.default_pianist() explicitly activated in an isolated temp folder

sourceNoteIdentitySemantics: IDs use instrument and note ordinals after PrettyMIDI decode; they are not raw SMF event IDs. A source-note-to-raw-SMF-event mapping is unavailable and must be designed by the M1 identity adapter.
